Title: Azure Data Factory announces Data Flow general availability in two new Azure regions

Body.Content:
Data Flows are ADF’s low-code visual data transformation tool that executes at scale with just-in-time Spark compute. Data Flows are now generally available in US Virginia and US Arizona Azure Gov Cloud regions.

Learn more.
